title: Not off to a good start
text: Recd my first box in July not impressed: glass serum no benefit, blush lip super drying on lips, dr jart sample soooo tiny, but ok product, gave acne dots to daughter.  The only product I liked was charcoal sheet mask, and did not receive eyeshadow for being new customer, sooo jury is still out.  If it does not improve will cancel.  Maybe one product was full size.  O’Sea face wash gentle but again small.  Was expecting more, but perhaps it’s an age thing.  If the blush was full size, the majority of the glass container was, well glass container lol. See photo  So it appears I paid $15 for a $3 face mask.  Please note the entire bottle glass portion was solid glass, it was difficult to photograph bottle with out shadow or glare. Will update with photo without lid.
label: negative
